core_obligations: Constructs the explicit extension-field concatenation and uses coordinatewise minimal-support scalar rigidity, followed by (q-1)-power intersection, to force global minimality of the concatenated code. This is a general algebraic coding construction; field-size specializations and direct blocking-set/rate corollaries are not separate targets.
